title: census.py apply keeps the artifact register in step and writes no address into a note
goal: census.py apply updates the sha256 of each kb/public/_artifacts.csv row whose file it changes, or refuses the part, and refuses a session result whose notes or rows hold a value the leak scan flags

run:
import inspect, sys
sys.path.insert(0, '_tools')
import census
s = inspect.getsource(census)
i = s.find('def cmd_apply')
sys.exit(0 if i >= 0 and '_artifacts' in s[i:i + 20000] and 'leak' in s[i:i + 20000] else 1)

notes: Retrospective of SP-rmp5zm5a (2026-10-22, operator accepted): fetch.py --offline failed after census apply changed privacy/gliner-models.csv (ST-vhtpgjb5) and mecm/log-files.csv and sql-views-compliance.csv (ST-bjwyl2bc) without their register hashes; test_leaks failed on a session note quoting the Python 3.14 release manager's address. Each was fixed by hand. The draft check reads source text.
